core_obligations: Reduce to the stalk over Z and move the derived pullback inside via flatness
Identify the I-power torsion of the cohomology modules
Apply the neighbourhood-isomorphism lemma to the mod-I isomorphism

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to the stalk over Z and move the derived pullback inside via flatness

difficulty_reason: Stalk computation at y-bar: away from f^{-1}Z both sides vanish; over Z use the stalk-pushforward-with-support lemma to get (Rf_*Q)_x = Q_y, flat base change to move the pullback inside, and reduce to Q_y ⊗ O_y ≅ Q_y in the derived category; the cohomology modules are I-power torsion (stalk-of-module-with-support), the flat local ring map O_x -> O_y is an isomorphism mod I (f^{-1}Z -> Z an isomorphism) and finitely generated I, so the neighbourhood-isomorphism lemma identifies the cohomology of the tensor with that of Q.
